title: Inside China's new $517 million natural history museum that takes visitors from the cosmos to human evolution, featuring meteorites, dinosaurs and a river-inspired design
summary_full: Shenzhen Natural History Museum opened on July 28, 2026, becoming southern China's first major institution dedicated to natural history.  The museum's design draws inspiration from a river delta, creating a flowing, curvilinear structure.  Visitors will journey from the cosmos through Earth's history and dinosaur eras and eventually learn about the delicate balance of our natural world.
